title: DRE-LZSH: SEEG benchmark dataset for drug-resistant epilepsy (ictal and interictal segments, 29 patients)
description: A stereo-EEG (SEEG) benchmark dataset from 29 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, containing ictal (seizure) and interictal segments recorded at 2000 Hz. It includes clinical information and channel-level epileptogenic-zone annotations, and is re-packaged in iEEG-BIDS from the authors' Zenodo release. Derivative HFO rate and 1/f spectral-fit results and the authors' code are also included.
methods_description: SEEG segments (seizure segments typically 40-60 s, plus longer interictal segments) were recorded at 2000 Hz. The original MATLAB arrays were converted to BrainVision IEEE float32 (stored float64 values rounded to float32) with BIDS sidecars, with no filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Channel types were inferred from channel names, and no electrode coordinates were available.
